title: Volo Museum launches new Paranormal Tours
excerpt: Explore the historic Volo Cemetery, examine chilling evidence and investigate the very areas where paranormal teams reported unexplained encounters.
content:
Volo Museum guests can explore the historic Volo Cemetery, an investigation room featuring hologram storytellers and video evidence, and follow a professional guide through locations where paranormal investigators have repeatedly reported unexplained activity on the museum’s new Paranormal Tours.

The tours run Saturdays and Sundays through Nov. 1.

According to a news release, the museum’s reported paranormal activity has been featured on TV programs including Discovery Channel’s “Ghost Lab” and Travel Channel’s “Paranormal Caught on Camera.”

The adventure begins with a trolley ride before guests step off to explore the history and mysteries of the property. At historic Volo Cemetery, the guide introduces the people behind the headstones and their possible connections to stories told throughout the museum grounds. Inside the new paranormal investigation room, guests will encounter a hologram presentation and examine photographs and security camera footage before heading out to explore reported paranormal hot spots throughout the museum property and 177-year-old Antique Malls.

Once the guided portion ends, guests can continue investigating designated areas on their own until closing.

This is a walking tour that includes stairs, uneven ground at the historic cemetery and extended periods of walking and standing.

Guests are encouraged to bring their own paranormal investigation equipment. Several free paranormal-themed apps are available for those who want to participate using their phones, and an investigation device will be available to buy for $20. Bring a smartphone to scan QR codes for clues and more detailed information throughout the antique mall.

Tours are available at 11 a.m., noon, 1 and 2 p.m. Saturdays and Sundays. The cost is $5 with any museum admission or combo pass in September and $10 in October. The tours are 30 to 45 minutes, with independent investigation available afterward until 5 p.m.

The Volo Museum is located at 27582 Volo Village Road, Volo.

Advance online reservations are encouraged as there is very limited seating. For tickets and details, visit volofun.com/event/paranormal-walking-tours.
